config.title: Configuration
config.subtitle: The lists agents choose from when they file a ticket.
config.departmentsHelp: Also routes the ticket — it is assigned within the department you pick.
config.categoriesHelp: What the ticket is about. Labels only — no routing.
config.prioritiesHelp: A new priority needs its own SLA policy, or no clock will run on it.
config.channelsHelp: How the ticket arrived. Built-in ones are written by connectors and cannot be deleted.
config.customerFieldsHelp: Suggested field names for customer details. Agents can still add their own.

sla.title: SLA policies
sla.subtitle: First-response and resolution targets per priority, in hours. Leave a field blank for no target.
sla.hint: Applies to new tickets and to any ticket whose priority changes — tickets already open keep the deadlines they were given. The resolve clock pauses while a ticket is Pending.

storage.title: Attachment storage
storage.subtitle: Where files uploaded to tickets are kept.
storage.localHint: Files stay on the Trackly server. Simple, but they are lost if the server is replaced and they don't survive scaling to more than one instance.
storage.bucketHint: Holds attachments and logos. Must already exist, and the credential needs object read, write and delete on it.
storage.pathPrefixHint: Folder inside the bucket everything is written under, e.g. trackly. Use one if the bucket is shared with another application.
storage.cdnHint: The origin that maps onto your public bucket's root — the bucket name is not part of a CDN path.
storage.previewHeading: A logo will be served from
storage.previewNeedsBucket: Set a public bucket to see the URL.
storage.cdnScope: Trackly only ever puts workspace logos on the CDN — never a ticket attachment, because a CDN link carries no sign-in. Note that a CDN needs this bucket to be publicly readable, and attachments live in it too: Trackly never publishes their paths, but it cannot make a public bucket private. Use a separate private bucket for attachments if that matters to you.
storage.gcsKeyShape: This doesn't look like a service-account key — it needs a private_key and a client_email.
storage.storedHint: Configured. Leave blank to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.
storage.testPassedBody: Trackly wrote a file, read it back and deleted it.
storage.switchWarning: Existing attachments stay where they are
storage.switchWarningBody: Files already uploaded remain in {{provider}} and are still served from there — but only while its credentials are kept below. Clearing them makes those attachments unreadable.

layout.subtitle: The cards in the ticket view's side panel: which are shown, and in what order.
layout.hint: Hiding a card only stops it being drawn. Nothing on the ticket changes, and switching it back on brings everything with it.
